newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable on thin interest.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable on thin interest.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable late on Friday amid thin buying interest as players preferred to stay on the sidelines, partly in response to the volatile rupiah, traders said.
"Goodrich is among the few buyers active in the market in recent days. I expect it to continue buying later today," one trader said.
However, traders said most players preferred to stay sidelined while the rupiah went through a volatile stage.

Traders said offer prices were quoted at 43.50 for August shipment fob Padang, 44.50 for October shipment fob Medan, 44.00 for August shipmnent fob Surabaya and 43.75 for August shipment fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Traders said prices could stay stable or fall next week depending on the movement of the rupiah against the dollar.
